acceptance.criterion: Parse and schema-validate the brief and verify evidence-backed component selection for every required function without relaxing the original requirements. Any unsupported selection remains an explicit failure or refusal, not acceptance.

Complete and verify electrical connectivity, supply and current budgets, signal compatibility, required decoupling and all supporting electrical/thermal calculations. Resolve every physical electrical binding and numerical requirement with evidence.
Verify a maximum 40 by 30 mm outline, bridge-output labeling, default-disable circuit, thermal copper and compact switching-current loops.
Run actual fabrication DRC against named profile CYCLE5_2L_FR4_1OZ, resolving violations and checking the requested stackup and single-side assembly. A named profile is not a claim that DRC has run.

Generate and cross-check manufacturing outputs: copper/mask/silkscreen/outline fabrication layers, drill files, stackup/fabrication notes, BOM, placement file and assembly drawing, with mutually consistent revision and coordinates.

Using an 8 ohm load rated >=2 W, differential analyzer, carrier-rejection filter and 0.5 m twisted output pair, verify gain, frequency response, 0.5 W continuous output, <=1% THD+N and <=75 degC surface temperature at both supply endpoints. Run each power/thermal test 10 minutes at 25 degC in still air; verify default disable and <=1 mA shutdown consumption. Review the hardware evidence against this unchanged functional envelope; no electrical or hardware success is pre-approved. The 10-minute run is a minimum, not the steady-state stopping criterion: continue until the stated equilibrium condition, and substantiate junction-temperature margin separately. Additionally verify the continuous 0.25 W operating target at 15 and 35 degC and support the bound between those ambients. Calibrate audio amplitudes at the loaded input connector.

constraints.description: All numerical requirements and fixture choices are independent ENGINEERING_DEFAULT decisions, not manufacturer facts. No part selections are prescribed.
External fixture supplies only the stated power, stimulus, host and load. Required signal conversion and conditioning remain on this board.

Named fabrication DRC profile CYCLE5_2L_FR4_1OZ: minimum finished trace width 0.20 mm, copper clearance 0.20 mm, plated drill 0.30 mm, annular ring 0.15 mm and copper-to-routed-edge clearance 0.30 mm. These are independent prototype fabrication defaults, not an assertion of any manufacturer capability.

requirements: Accept ground-referenced single-ended analog audio through an on-board AC coupling path. Source output impedance is at most 1 kohm and source DC offset lies within +/-50 mV.
Board input impedance must be at least 10 kohm at 1 kHz. Source amplitude is adjustable from zero to 0.25 Vrms; no digital audio source or external power amplifier is allowed.

All stated input Vrms amplitudes and DC offsets refer to the actual loaded board line-input connector relative to board ground, not the generator open-circuit setting. The source impedance limit is its Thevenin output impedance; calibrate the connector amplitude with the board connected.

power_settle_time.note: Independent fixture/interface default added by blind scope review.

requirements: Use a switching class-D output stage on the board, not a linear output stage or an external amplifier module.

Deliver at least 0.5 W continuous sine-wave power into an 8 ohm resistive differential load at 1 kHz, at each supply-range endpoint and at 25 degC ambient. At that operating point, THD+N shall be <=1% measured with a 20 Hz to 20 kHz bandwidth and appropriate analyzer switching-carrier rejection.

Nominal midband voltage gain is 10 V/V, permitted range 9 to 11 V/V at 1 kHz and 0.1 Vrms input, measured differentially across the load. Input amplitude may be adjusted within the declared envelope for the power test.
Relative to 1 kHz gain, response must stay within +/-3 dB from 100 Hz to 10 kHz at 0.1 Vrms input into 8 ohm.
Both speaker terminals are driven; neither may be grounded. Board includes all stability and switching-output components required by its chosen implementation for a 0.5 m twisted speaker pair.

Provide active-high ENABLE at 3.3 V host logic with on-board default-low bias. Low or disconnected ENABLE stops switching and consumes <=1 mA total board supply current. High enables normal audio operation.

With the board edge-supported horizontally in still air, no enclosure, no heatsink or fan, sustain the 0.5 W test continuously without thermal shutdown at 25 degC ambient. Run for at least 10 minutes and continue until thermal equilibrium, defined as hottest measured package surface changing by less than 1 degC over a further 5-minute window; the surface must remain <=75 degC throughout. Ten minutes alone is not proof of steady-state junction temperature. Separately substantiate junction temperature margin using implementation-specific dissipation and thermal evidence. Operational ambient range is 15 to 35 degC; at every ambient in that range require at least 0.25 W continuous output into 8 ohm at 1 kHz with <=1% THD+N, normal gain/enable/shutdown behavior and <=75 degC surface temperature. The stricter 0.5 W rated-power qualification remains at 25 degC only.
No short-circuit, EMC certification, pop-noise or maximum unclipped-power claim is required.

Controlled fixture sequence: connect common ground; hold ENABLE low; apply board power and allow at least 100 ms settling; connect the audio signal, then assert ENABLE. Before board power removal, deassert ENABLE, disconnect the audio signal and hold ENABLE at 0 V until power is removed. An unpowered board must not receive a high ENABLE or any driven audio signal. Host is powered before the board and removed afterward; no arbitrary power ordering or hot plugging is required.
Expose separate OUT_P and OUT_N and label both as driven outputs, with no speaker-return connection to ground.

functions.description: Regulated external DC entry and board power distribution
requirements: Accept the declared external regulated supply at the power connector and distribute it with implementation-required local decoupling. Any internally derived rails and their budgets remain on-board responsibilities; the source is not a substitute for core signal conversion.

interfaces.description: External 5 V regulated supply at board terminals.
Single-ended audio input; 0.25 Vrms maximum sine plus allowed DC offset gives this peak pin envelope.
External common-ground logic: <=0.4 V low, >=2.8 V high, maximum 3.465 V. Default disabled if disconnected.
Bridge output; voltage is differential instantaneous operating envelope, current is maximum intended peak load current, not a protection guarantee.

manufacturing.note: No mandatory mounting holes; fixture supports board edges with insulated clips. Board dimensions include connectors, excluding mating cables.

sources.description: Regulated external DC supply; stated operating range applies at board connector.

summary: A compact analog-input class-D board delivering modest loudspeaker power from an external 5 V source.
title: Mono bridge-output class-D audio amplifier
